explanation: A title referring to God and his sovereignty over all things.
To express admiration, gratitude, and reverence toward God for his works and grace.
To establish or create something, here used of God's actions and power in the world.
The holy city, center of Jewish faith and culture, as well as the site of the first temple.
To bring together or unite, here referring to God's gathering of his people from exile.
To restore health or wholeness, here used of God's ability to heal broken hearts.
To keep track of numbers, here regarding God's knowledge of the stars and their names.
Possessing great strength, power, or influence, here referring to God's infinite might.
The ability to think, comprehend, and learn, here about God's wisdom and insight.
To spread or distribute, here regarding God's act of giving snow and frost upon the earth.
To command or instruct someone to go somewhere, here about God's control over weather and nature.
A unit of language representing an idea or concept, here referring to God's commands and teachings.
